title: Package executor schema
description: Packages a Helm chart and optionally pushes it to an OCI registry.

chartFolder.description: Folder of the chart, relative to the workspace root.

outputFolder.description: Folder for the packaged chart, relative to the workspace root or absolute.

chartVersion.description: Overrides the chart version when packaging (`helm package --version`).

appVersion.description: Overrides the app version when packaging (`helm package --app-version`).

remote.description: OCI registry to push the chart to, e.g. `oci://ghcr.io/my-org/charts`. Required when `push` is set.

plainHttp.description: Use plain HTTP instead of TLS for OCI registries: when pushing the chart (`helm push --plain-http`) and when downloading OCI dependencies (`helm dependency update/build --plain-http`). Helm v4 needs this for registries without TLS, including localhost.

updateDependencies.description: Run `helm dependency update` before packaging. This re-resolves the dependencies and rewrites Chart.lock.

buildDependencies.description: Run `helm dependency build` before packaging. This downloads the dependencies pinned in Chart.lock, or resolves them when there is no Chart.lock yet.

repositories.description: Chart repositories to add with `helm repo add` before handling dependencies. oci:// and file:// repositories are used directly and not added.

url.description: URL of the repository (https://, http://, oci:// or file://). Must not contain credentials; use username and passwordEnv.

username.description: Username for a repository that needs authentication.

passwordEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the repository password. It is passed to helm through stdin, never on the command line.
